name: Sorrel Furrow
tagline: Read the ground beneath you like a founding document.
positioning: Sorrel Furrow turns a handful of dirt into a living map of pH, nitrogen, and microbial destiny — for the gardener who refuses to guess.

hero.h1: The soil under your feet is a civilization. Start governing it.
hero.sub: Mail us a scoop of your garden bed. We return a full-spectrum analysis of pH, nitrogen, organic matter, and microbial vitality — plus a season-by-season plan any gardener can actually follow.

features.title: Full-Spectrum Panels
features.description: Fourteen measurements from pH to cation exchange, rendered in plain language — not a lab printout you need a chemistry degree to decode.

features.title: Bed-by-Bed Mapping
features.description: Track every raised bed, orchard row, and container as its own living record. Watch your soil evolve across seasons and amendments.

features.title: Amendment Playbooks
features.description: Every report ends with a ranked list of exactly what to add, how much, and when — down to the bag of compost.

features.title: Yield Forecasting
features.description: See how this year's numbers project into next year's harvest, so you spend on the amendments that actually move the needle.

features.title: Archived Forever
features.description: Every sample you've ever sent, preserved in one timeline. Build a multi-decade record of the ground you steward.

features.title: Regional Benchmarks
features.description: Compare your dirt against thousands of gardens in your climate zone and know whether you're ahead of the curve.

testimonials.quote: I stopped throwing money at random fertilizer. Sorrel Furrow told me my beds were starved for potassium, not nitrogen — my tomatoes have never been this obscene.
testimonials.name: Marisol Deering

testimonials.quote: As a first-time landowner I had five acres and zero clue. The bed-by-bed maps turned a decade of guesswork into a two-page plan I now follow like scripture.
testimonials.name: Emmett Cho

testimonials.quote: The archived timeline is the killer feature. I can prove my no-till plot rebuilt three points of organic matter in four years. That's my legacy in a chart.
testimonials.name: Dana Whitfield

pricing.blurb: A single deep analysis of one bed or plot, mailed to you.
Four seasonal kits and a living map of your whole garden.
For serious homesteads treating soil as generational capital.

homepage.footerBlurb: Sorrel Furrow is soil intelligence for people who dig their own dirt. Mail a scoop, read your ground, and steward it like the frontier it is.
